app.name: Nutrition Kitchen
app.tagline: Enter a recipe, read its nutrition facts.

footer.attribution: Nutrient values: Max Rubner-Institut, {source}, as an extract, {license}

sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: The nutrient values come from these open databases. Every value names its source.

rows.label: Ingredients
rows.empty: No ingredients yet. Type above, for example “flour”.

row.loadFailed: The values could not be loaded.

builder.draftBroken: The saved draft was damaged and has been discarded.

amount.invalid: Please enter a number of grams, for example 12.5.

bakingLoss.label: Baking loss
bakingLoss.hint: What evaporates in the oven. Taken off the water.
bakingLoss.noWater: The baking loss needs a row of water in the recipe.
bakingLoss.exceedsWater: The baking loss ({loss} g) is more than the water in the recipe ({water} g).

label.empty: The label appears here as soon as an ingredient has an amount.
label.refused: Nothing can be calculated from these entries:
label.copied: The label is on the clipboard.

gaps.energy: The energy is calculated without them.

weight.zero: The recipe weighs 0 g. Give at least one ingredient an amount.

value.above100: 100 g cannot hold more than 100 g of it.

salt.sodiumMismatch: Salt ({salt} g) and sodium ({sodium} g) do not match: salt is sodium times 2.5.

label.bakingLoss: The baking loss does not fit the water in the recipe. See below the ingredients.

material.title: Own raw material
material.hint: Values per 100 g, as on the data sheet. Leave empty what it does not state. The app calculates the energy itself.
material.name: Name
material.namePlaceholder: for example the baking agent of your supplier
material.invalid: Please enter a number, for example 12.5.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: You only need an account to save and share recipes. For that we store your name and an identifier of your account, no email address.

failed.google: Signing in with Google did not work. Please try again.
failed.bluesky: Signing in with Bluesky did not work. Check your handle and try again.

book.empty: No recipes yet. Build one and save it.
book.deleteFinal: The recipe and its photo will be gone.
book.replaceConfirm: The recipe in the editor is replaced by “{title}”.
book.noEnergy: No label yet: amounts are missing.
